tokens.name: color-burgundy-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand and logo colour: primary buttons, Sale badge, selected chips, footer ground, key highlights. As text on ivory-50 (10.4:1), white or burgundy-100 (8.8:1). Keep to about 10% of any screen.

tokens.name: color-burgundy-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with burgundy-600. ivory-50 text on it reads 12.9:1.

tokens.name: color-burgundy-100
tokens.usage: Selected filter tint, tinted info boxes, the New badge ground. Text on it is burgundy-600 (8.8:1).

tokens.name: color-ivory-50
tokens.usage: The default page canvas. Also the text colour on burgundy-600 and burgundy-700 fills, and the logo on burgundy.

tokens.name: color-sand-200
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, muted sections, the trust strip and the Sold out badge ground. ink-900 on it reads 11.2:1; ink-600 only 4.4:1 (see Sold out badge).

tokens.name: color-sand-300
tokens.usage: Borders, input and chip outlines, disabled button fill. Note: 1.7:1 on white and 1.6:1 on ivory, below the 3:1 WCAG asks of control borders; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: color-gold-400
tokens.usage: Decorative accent only: dividers, icons on dark grounds, sparkle details, the focus ring. NOT for text on ivory (2.5:1). As a focus ring it is 2.5:1 on ivory and 2.7:1 on white, under the 3:1 WCAG asks; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: color-gold-700
tokens.usage: Accent text and links, discount percentages, "Free delivery" labels, trust-strip icons. On ivory-50 4.7:1, on white 5.0:1; on sand-200 only 3.7:1, so use it there for icons, not small text.

tokens.name: color-ink-900
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ivory-50 (14.2:1), white, sand-200 and the status tints. Never use pure black.

tokens.name: color-ink-600
tokens.usage: Captions, secondary text, struck-through prices on ivory-50 (5.6:1) and white (5.9:1). Disabled button text on sand-300 (3.5:1, disabled controls are exempt).

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Cards that sit above ivory, input fields.

tokens.name: color-success-600
tokens.usage: Feedback only: order placed, in stock. Text on success-100 (5.4:1) or white. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: color-success-100
tokens.usage: Success toast and message ground, under success-600 or ink-900 text.

tokens.name: color-warning-600
tokens.usage: Feedback only: low stock, delivery delay. Text on warning-100 (5.2:1).

tokens.name: color-warning-100
tokens.usage: Low stock badge and warning message ground, under warning-600 text.

tokens.name: color-error-600
tokens.usage: Feedback only: form errors, out of stock. Input error border; error text on white (7.0:1) or error-100 (5.8:1).

tokens.name: color-error-100
tokens.usage: Error toast and message ground, under error-600 or ink-900 text.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Semantic: the page background. Use this, not the raw colour, in components.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic: product cards, inputs, sheets that sit on bg-page.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic: placeholders, muted sections, trust strip.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic: primary buttons, footer, cart count badge.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Semantic: selected and tinted states.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Semantic: body text and headings on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-muted.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Semantic: captions and meta on bg-page and bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic: brand-coloured text on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Semantic: accent text, links and discounts on bg-page and bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic: text and icons on bg-brand and burgundy-700.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Semantic: card, input and chip borders (see sand-300 contrast note).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Semantic: strong dividers and emphasised outlines.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic: the 3px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px (see gold-400 contrast note).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero title, text-4xl: 44px on mobile, 64px from 768px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Quilted shoulder bag with gold chain
styles.usage: Product names on cards and lead text, text-lg, leading-snug.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pay when your bag arrives. ব্যাগ হাতে পেয়ে টাকা দিন।
styles.usage: Body copy and inputs, text-base. Never smaller for reading text.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices: weight 600, never italic, always with the ৳ symbol.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges only, text-xs. UPPERCASE with tracking-label for short labels, never sentences.

fontSize.note: The type scale as CSS variables. Mobile values; bundle.css raises text-4xl to 64px from 768px.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: 12px. Badges only.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: 14px. Meta, captions, delivery notes.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: 16px. Body and inputs; the floor for reading text (also stops iOS zoom).

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: 18px. Product names, lead text.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: 22px. Section headings.

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: 28px. Page titles.

tokens.name: text-3xl
tokens.usage: 36px. Hero subtitle.

tokens.name: text-4xl
tokens.usage: 44px hero title on mobile; 64px (4rem) from 768px via bundle.css.

tokens.name: leading-tight
tokens.usage: Display headings.

tokens.name: leading-snug
tokens.usage: Subheads, product names.

tokens.name: leading-normal
tokens.usage: Body. Bangla always uses this or taller.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Emphasis, display medium.

tokens.name: weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Headings, buttons, prices, badges.

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Display headings.

tokens.name: tracking-label
tokens.usage: UPPERCASE short labels only ("NEW", "BEST SELLER").

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding, hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between adjacent tap targets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product card text-area padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side padding, default gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Wishlist tap target.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: container-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding: 16px mobile, 32px from 768px via bundle.css.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height: 64px mobile, 80px from 768px via bundle.css.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height for buttons, inputs, chips and steppers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards, sheets, modals, product images.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, filter pills, cart count.

shadow.note: Warm shadows only, tinted ink or burgundy. Never grey rgba(0,0,0).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest; the header once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card hover on desktop, with a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Cart drawer, bottom sheets and modals.

duration.note: Motion confirms an action, never decorates. bundle.css sets all to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Taps, button and chip state changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Panels, drawers, sheets.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Page-level reveals, image fade-in.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.
